newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Broadway sets share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Broadway sets share buyback.

text.p: Broadway Industries Ltd said on Friday it planned to back back 32 shares out of every hundred held at NZ$1.25 per share.
"This is the equivalent of a capital repayment of 40 cents per share," the company said.
The company earlier announced a first half net profit of NZ$8.26 million for the six months to December, compared with a loss of $573,000 for the previous comparable period.
The result included an extraordinary gain of NZ$8.32 million on the sale of Chemstock Animal Health.
Pre-tax operating profit of $82,000 was an improvement on last year's operating loss of $573,000.
"The restructuring process previously announced continues," the company said.

It said directors had previously indicated a pre-tax operating profit of $2 million for the full year to June 30, but this had been reviewed due to the difficulties experienced in Southern Packaging and the slower than anticipated recovery in the Food Service Division of Mercer Stainless.
"The operating result is likely to be break-even for the full year," the company said.
